verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's DLSS docs cover Super Resolution, DLAA, Ray Reconstruction and RTX 50-exclusive Multi Frame Generation (up to five generated frames per rendered frame on fifth-gen Tensor Cores), with the NVIDIA app upgrading hundreds of games to the latest DLSS features. TechPowerUp independently confirms the RTX 5080 includes all the new RTX 50 features. Missing for 10: independent hands-on measurement of DLSS/MFG quality and performance on the 5080, and third-party corroboration of the breadth of game support beyond NVIDIA's 'hundreds of games' claim.
